label: D2: arrived at S1 via rare transition after choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state is S1 (recall 0.999 for D2 & S1, but precision 0.19). Most of the mass (81%) is on rare a2->S1 transitions; recorded predicate D2 & S1 & a2 (dev F1 0.51, mass recall 0.81). All variables are observed at D2. Magnitude is largest for a2->S1 rare when the previous trial reached S1 (often a1 S1c rewarded) i.e. a surprising arrival at the state the agent favoured (adding prev_state==1 gives precision 0.67, mass 0.59). Common a1->S1 arrivals give weak activations (~0.05 of max), mostly late in the episode and when the model value is lower; adding value<7.13 to the disjunction raises mass recall to 0.98 but F1 only to 0.55. Many a2->S1 rare steps after an S2 streak are silent. Never fires at D1/GO or at S2.
